runeforger.name: Runeforger
runeforger.desc: Binding and Light come easier. Cheaper Refined Mana for enchantments and permanent Glyph items, once those exist.

alchemical_theorist.name: Alchemical Theorist
alchemical_theorist.desc: Cold and Force come easier, and a keen eye for useful plants (+10% gathered). Pre-cast potions arrive with Refined Mana.

kinetic_logician.name: Kinetic Logician
kinetic_logician.desc: Force and Motion come easier, and a redirected blow means 10% fewer wounds.

axiom_monk.name: Contemplative Axiom Monk
axiom_monk.desc: Light comes easier. Casts cost 2 less FP, Instability DCs are 20% lower, and checks of DC 10 or less always succeed.
